reported.value: $5.1 billion, up 1.7% YoY in constant currency
reported.quote: Revenue for Q3 was $5.1 bn, up 0.6% sequentially and 1.7% year-on-year basis in constant currency terms.
Our adjusted operating margin was 21.2%. We generated free cash flow of $915 mn.
Our large deals were at $4.8 bn with 57% net new. This was across 26 deals.
One of the most significant large deals we won was with the National Health Service in the U.K. This $1.6 bn deal expands our work in the healthcare sector.

reported.value: 5,000 increase to reach total headcount of 337,000
reported.quote: Net headcount increased by 5,000 to 337,000 employees. LTM attrition declined by 2% sequentially and 1.4% on a year-on-year basis
During the quarter, we successfully completed our largest ever buyback, returning INR18,000 crores to our shareholders, which will help EPS accretion.

business: Infosys Limited provides IT consulting, digital transformation, cloud services, and AI-led solutions across enterprise software platforms. Its primary client verticals include Financial Services, Energy, Utilities, Resources & Services (EURS), Manufacturing, Retail & CPG, Healthcare & Life Sciences, Communications, and Hi-Tech.
